content.text:
The drawing is a benzene ring with four substituents. Reading the ring vertices:

- Top vertex: bonded to nothing extra (CH).
- Upper right: NH2.
- Lower right: NO2.
- Bottom vertex: CH.
- Lower left: F.
- Upper left: Cl.

So the ring runs C1(NH2), C2(NO2), C3(H), C4(F), C5(Cl), C6(H). This is 5-chloro-4-fluoro-2-nitroaniline.

SMILES: Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]

SMILES: Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]
